status: Pre-outcome protocol, conditional external historical validation; no team non-exposure or original license independently established
source: Shen et al., JD.com: Transaction-Level Data for the 2020 MSOM Data Driven Research Challenge, doi:10.1287/msom.2020.0900; Tables 4/5, footnotes 13/17; user-provided files match public mirror SHA256
model: Use exactly archived Review_V3/evidence/fitted_model.json, January calibration, not the distinct AEGIS_App/review_v3 February diagnostic. Raw and calibrated scores both reported; no fit, tuning, or selection using JD records.
time_window: 2018-03-01 inclusive through 2018-03-25 exclusive; cutoff 2018-04-01 exclusive; reserve final 7 days for observation; historical local calendar timestamps as recorded
population: Unique nonmissing order ID; all rows first-party type 1, consistent valid purchase timestamp and order date and positive integral promise; exactly one matching delivery row, package ID equals order ID and delivery type 1 (paper: package contains all SKUs); valid arrival >= purchase and arrival before cutoff; deadline day before cutoff. No matching delivery or malformed or ambiguous records excluded, never coded negative.
deadline: Promise 1 before 11:00 same day; 11:00 to before 23:00 next day; >=23:00 ambiguous excluded. Promise integer >1: purchase calendar day + promise days. No intraday SLA claim.
label: Actual customer arrival calendar date strictly later than promised calendar date, as in Olist; conditional on observed comparable delivered orders only.
metrics: Prevalence, AP, ROC AUC, Brier, log loss, signed mean probability minus prevalence; raw and January calibrated score; frozen Olist training prevalence constant baseline, test prevalence as descriptive ranking reference; reliability bins [0,.02,.04,.06,.08,.10,.15,.20,.30,.50,1].
uncertainty: 500 purchase-calendar-day cluster bootstrap replicates, seed 20261125, percentile 95% intervals for both score variants; fixed model, temporal dependence between days and sampling bias not captured. No causal or prospective claims.
outputs: Aggregate-only report, counts and metrics, no raw JD rows or individual predictions published. Record source, protocol, model, script hashes and runtime versions.
